entities.name: Zygmunt Pawłowicz

entities.summary: Zygmunt Józef Pawłowicz was the Polish Auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Gdańsk from 1985 until 2005. He was also ordained the titular bishop of Tamallula in 1985.
